description: Production-corpus paraphrase fixtures for the s82 recall gate (measure-retrieval-production.ts). Each query is a genuine semantic paraphrase of its source row sharing <2 meaningful content-word stems with it — simulating the production paraphrase failure mode (TraceLab CMOS-CONTEXT-RETRIEVAL-01-02, ~50% zero-result on paraphrase queries) so BM25 mostly misses and the vector arm carries recall. Re-authored s82-m02 against the POST-FLUSH active corpus (m01 flush): every expected_id is active (decisions/learnings) or a live mission, and grown to 8 fixtures per type / 24 total. Source rows pulled directly from cmos/db/cmos.sqlite.

fixtures.query: where do the rule manifests ride along when we publish to the registry
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Foundational-docs are alive (bundled via cmos-seed/, ship inside the npm tarball). Research papers are point-in-time snapshots (NOT bundled, repo-hygiene only).

fixtures.query: switched live search lookups to use the fused ranking backend
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Sprint-66 m05 hot-path migration. All 5 production retrieval call sites now route through HybridRetriever (BM25 + sqlite-vec via RRF k=60).

fixtures.query: why refuse and error out rather than guessing which owner a request belongs to
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Sender resolution fails closed. When the local project cannot be authoritatively identified (no dashboard_project_id in metadata AND no directory-entry match by cmos_address), return undefined — never fall back to 'first project for user'. A 400 is strictly better than silent mis-attribution.

fixtures.query: why did we decide against shipping a separate command line executable for signing in
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Sprint 58 scope rejection: cmos-mcp login bin NOT included. MCP tool covers every real use case (agent, human-via-agent, Claude Desktop) because tool response renders verificationUri/userCode in host UI. User confirmed no terminal-only audience.

fixtures.query: some lookups hand back gigantic dumps that blow past the response ceiling and need slimming
fixtures.source_text_snippet: s70 build-session UX-feedback pattern: cmos_mission(action=status) and cmos_message(action=list) both returned 80KB+ payloads that exceeded the tool-result token cap, forcing jq workarounds. Candidate fix: pin status to the resolved project and trim message bodies in the list view.

fixtures.query: why do deployment focused work cycles keep leaving no activity records behind
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Open a CMOS session at the START of every sprint, including ops/distribution/release sprints — s73's 0-sessions/1-learning outlier proved release-shaped sprints are NOT exempt from capture. Pair with closing the planning session before build starts.

fixtures.query: why scan an outside repo's entire commit past for exposed secrets before wiring protections
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Any sprint that publishes or mirrors to a PRE-EXISTING external destination MUST include a destination pre-flight history leak-audit as mission 01 — clone the live target and leak-grep the FULL history, not just HEAD — before any guard or pipeline work is designed.

fixtures.query: records quietly stopped uploading after i changed a secret and skipped signing back in
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Treat a credential rotation as INCOMPLETE until live sync is green: after any rotation, immediately update/delete the stale local .env value, re-run cmos_auth login to re-mint the device-code key, and confirm cmos_status shows a fresh last_sync_at.

fixtures.query: one toggle that disables multiple unrelated safety checks is a smell
fixtures.source_text_snippet: When a flag means 'ignore the guard AND ignore the cursor,' those are two independent concerns that should be separate flags. force=true conflated 'bypass large-delta guard' with 'replay from scratch.'

fixtures.query: why we abandoned per-message remote dispatch for the journal upload
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Event-replay sync (one HTTP POST per event) is not a viable path for large event logs. At real network latency (2-3s/request), 1000 events = 2500s needed vs 120s budget.

fixtures.query: agents need every input field documented or they have nothing to bind
fixtures.source_text_snippet: MCP inputSchema must describe its object shape fully, or agents can't tell what keys to send. fieldUpdates was declared as items:{type:'object'} — no property spec; Zod stripped the unknown key.

fixtures.query: incremental table-evolution approach handles growing column counts
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Sprint 61 retro — the lazy ensureXxxTable migration pattern proved extensible under real load. m03 added the evergreen column via ensureLearningsTable on both read AND write paths — no new helper.

fixtures.query: search relevance scores come back as minus values so largest doesn't sort first before freshness weighting
fixtures.source_text_snippet: FTS5 rank quirk: SQLite FTS5 returns rank as a negative float (more negative = better BM25 match). Using abs(rank) normalizes to higher-is-better semantics before applying the recency decay formula.

fixtures.query: why does my batch job keep redoing identical rows forever whenever it restarts
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Cursor-based resume strategies must be advance-only. Any write to a cursor position must check: new value > current value before committing. A cursor that can regress turns a recoverable timeout into an infinite loop replaying the same work.

fixtures.query: multiple groups flag one glitch separately is that a fluke or a genuine defect
fixtures.source_text_snippet: When two independent teams report the same bug with the same symptom ('backfill stuck, cursor not advancing'), treat it as a systemic fault, not a coincidence. Cross-project message patterns are a diagnostic surface — two identical complaints = confirmed bug.

fixtures.query: how do i confirm outbound notes get credited to the right author without another team's involvement
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Self-send to cmos://derek/<own-project> is the cheapest live attribution probe: if the dashboard rejects with HTTP 400 'Cannot send a message to the same project,' sender-side resolution is correct; if it accepts, the sender is being mis-attributed.

fixtures.query: keep unit suites from corrupting the shared workspace index
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Registry isolation: test configDir audit + prune + startup validate. Stop the registry leak at the source and drain the pool. The user registry at ~/.config/cmos-mcp/project-registry.json is at 1935 entries and growing.

fixtures.query: build the browser-approval authentication handshake
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Device code bootstrap + local key store. Implement RFC 8628 device code flow as MCP's bootstrap credential primitive. On first MCP send/init with no local credentials, call POST /api/auth/device/code.

fixtures.query: make the registration handshake invokable from an editor host
fixtures.source_text_snippet: cmos_auth(action='login') — MCP-reachable device-code bootstrap. Expose runDeviceCodeFlow as an MCP tool action so agents and IDE hosts can trigger the bootstrap without a terminal.

fixtures.query: switch the team-directory call from the legacy address to the opt-in one
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Migrate listDirectory() to /api/projects/directory/public. Swap dashboard-client.listDirectory() URL from the now-scoped /api/projects/directory to the new opt-in /api/projects/directory/public.

fixtures.query: set up metadata so we can release under our scoped namespace
fixtures.source_text_snippet: npm packaging (@aquex/cmos-mcp). Configure package.json for first npm publish under the @aquex scope. Fields: name=@aquex/cmos-mcp, version=1.0.0, bin entry pointing at the cmos-mcp CLI launcher.

fixtures.query: give the keyword indexes coverage on every persistable type and reserve room for dense lookups
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Vector storage + FTS5 parity schema migration. Add an idempotent schema migration that (a) provisions vector storage for strategic_decisions / learnings / missions per the m01 ADR, and (b) brings FTS5 to parity.

fixtures.query: first-time job that fills semantic search storage for our entire existing corpus
fixtures.source_text_snippet: Embedding pipeline + one-shot backfill. Implement the embedding pipeline that populates vector storage on every write to decisions/learnings/missions, plus a one-shot backfill script that embeds the 1,152 existing rows.

fixtures.query: why do simultaneous saves to my auth file silently clobber each other and vanish
fixtures.source_text_snippet: CredentialStore singleton cache invalidation. Fix the architectural bug where the CredentialStore singleton caches credentials.json on first load() and never re-reads from disk, causing the second of two concurrent writers to lose their data.
